name: Foam Roller Lat Roll
description: Lying on your side with a foam roller under your armpit and your bottom arm stretched overhead, push with your top foot to roll slowly down the side of your back and up again.

source.title: NASM Exercise Library: Foam Roll Latissimus Dorsi

setup: Lie on your side, the foam roller just under your armpit, bottom arm stretched overhead.
Bend your top leg and plant that foot on the floor in front.
cues: Thumb of the bottom hand turned up.

prescription.note: Roll slowly between your armpit and the middle of your ribs; stay on the side of your back, not your ribs or lower back.

keyframes.name: Roller under your armpit
keyframes.cue: On your side, bottom arm overhead, the roller just under your armpit, top foot planted in front.

keyframes.name: Roll to your mid-back
keyframes.cue: Push with your top foot to roll down your side to the middle of your ribs, then back.
